---
title: "Machine Learning"
---

These are the works produced for SIT720 Machine Learning unit. I have developed practical skills in applying core machine learning techniques to solve real-world problems and uncover hidden insights in data.

* **Supervised Learning:** Proficient in building and applying linear and non-linear classification models to predict outcomes.
* **Unsupervised Learning:** Experienced in using clustering and factor analysis to identify hidden patterns and structures in datasets.
* **Model Validation:** Skilled in analyzing data representation and selecting the appropriate model complexity to ensure accurate and reliable results.
* **Practical Application:** Applied these techniques to solve real-world scenarios, demonstrating an ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
